description: Hand-labeled query -> relevant article id(s) pairs for evaluating semantic retrieval (GET /search) against something other than intuition. Corpus is a fixed set of realistic biotech headline/summary pairs spanning multiple topics on purpose, so an embedder that just matches shared words on irrelevant topics gets penalized. See scripts/eval_retrieval.py.
